title: Drone Delivery Unit Cost vs. Ground Delivery (2024-2028)
executive_question: Can drone delivery achieve cost parity with ground delivery within the planning horizon?
required_metrics: {'year': 2024, 'metric': 'Drone delivery cost per package', 'value': 12.5, 'unit': 'USD', 'entity': 'Industry average (Zipline, Wing)'}
{'year': 2025, 'metric': 'Drone delivery cost per package', 'value': 11.2, 'unit': 'USD', 'entity': 'Industry average (estimated via learning curve)'}
{'year': 2026, 'metric': 'Drone delivery cost per package', 'value': 10.1, 'unit': 'USD', 'entity': 'Industry average (estimated via learning curve)'}
{'year': 2027, 'metric': 'Drone delivery cost per package', 'value': 9.3, 'unit': 'USD', 'entity': 'Industry average (estimated via learning curve)'}
{'year': 2028, 'metric': 'Drone delivery cost per package', 'value': 8.7, 'unit': 'USD', 'entity': 'Industry average (estimated via learning curve)'}
comparison_set: Drone delivery vs. ground delivery cost per package, annual 2024-2028
search_queries: drone delivery cost per package 2024 Zipline Wing
UPS last mile delivery cost per package 2024
FedEx ground delivery cost per package 2024
data_quality_rule: Use actual reported costs for 2024; for 2025-2028, apply a 10% annual learning curve for drone costs and 2% annual efficiency improvement for ground costs. Mark projected years as estimates.
narrative_role: Establishes the cost disadvantage trend and shows whether projected learning curves close the gap.
pre_exhibit_context: Management questions whether drone delivery can ever be cost-competitive with traditional last-mile ground delivery.
post_exhibit_takeaway: Drone delivery unit costs remain above $10 per package through 2028, while ground delivery costs stay near $5, making cost parity unlikely without breakthrough technology.

title: Consumer Willingness to Pay for Drone Delivery (2024)
executive_question: Are consumers willing to pay a premium for drone delivery that covers its higher cost?
search_queries: consumer willingness to pay drone delivery survey 2024
drone delivery premium price consumer survey 2024
McKinsey last mile delivery consumer willingness to pay
data_quality_rule: Use survey data from nationally representative samples. If multiple surveys exist, use the most recent and cite sample size.
narrative_role: Demonstrates that consumer WTP is below the break-even price, undermining revenue potential.
pre_exhibit_context: The business case assumes consumers will pay a premium for speed, but actual WTP data is needed.
post_exhibit_takeaway: Over 70% of consumers are unwilling to pay more than $5 for drone delivery, far below the estimated unit cost of $12.50.

title: Drone Delivery Adoption Funnel: TAM to Realistic Volume (2024)
executive_question: What is the realistic daily package volume after accounting for consumer acceptance and regulatory constraints?
search_queries: total packages delivered daily New York City 2024
FAA drone no-fly zones urban areas map
drone delivery adoption rate consumer survey 2024
data_quality_rule: Use actual data for TAM and regulatory constraints; for adoption and competition, use survey and market share data. Mark any assumptions clearly.
narrative_role: Shows the dramatic reduction from theoretical maximum to achievable volume, highlighting key bottlenecks.
pre_exhibit_context: The business case often starts with a large TAM, but real-world constraints reduce it significantly.
post_exhibit_takeaway: After accounting for regulatory restrictions (70% area loss) and consumer acceptance (50% adoption), realistic volume is only 15% of TAM, or 22,500 packages per day.
